method: sysfs /sys/bus/pci/devices/*/current_link_speed|width sampled at 2 Hz from host while VM ran faster-whisper ASR (24.6s, 124s audio). 120 samples covering full ASR window.
bandwidth: PCIe Gen1 x4: 2.5 GT/s per lane; after 8b/10b encoding, ~8 Gbit/s aggregate payload = ~1.0 GB/s per direction, before PCIe protocol overhead

gpu0_gtx1050.endpoint_lnksta: Speed 2.5GT/s (Gen1, downgraded), Width x4 (downgraded from x16)
gpu0_gtx1050.slot: GA-B250-HD3P PCIEX4_1 (physical x16, electrical x4, PCH-side)
gpu0_gtx1050.notes: Endpoint advertises Gen3 x16 but is limited to x4 by the upstream PCH root port. Speed is at Gen1 despite Gen3 target (LnkCtl2=8GT/s). Never transitions to Gen2/Gen3 during ASR load (120 samples).

gpu1_gt1030.slot: GA-B250-HD3P PCIEX4_2 (physical x16, electrical x4, PCH-side)
gpu1_gt1030.notes: Card and slot are both x4. Speed at Gen1 despite Gen3 target. Same behavior as 1050.

topology.gpu0_gtx1050_path: CPU → DMI → B250 PCH → PCIEX4_1 (x4) → GP107
topology.gpu1_gt1030_path: CPU → DMI → B250 PCH → PCIEX4_2 (x4) → GP108
topology.virtualization: VFIO passthrough to QEMU VM (Q35 + ICH9 virtual chipset)
topology.note: Both Pascal GPUs are on PCH-side PCIe (not CPU-direct). The RTX 3060 occupies the CPU-direct PCIEX16 slot.

cause_of_speed_downgrade: Unresolved. LnkCtl2 targets Gen3 on all four ports (both endpoints and both root ports), but all operate at Gen1. No AER errors; PCIe equalization completed successfully. Possible explanations: BIOS PCIe speed override, DMI/PCH firmware policy, link-training behavior, or signal integrity. The absence of AER errors and successful equalization makes a catastrophic signal problem less likely but does not diagnose the cause.
conclusion: Both GPUs operate at Gen1 x4 (~1.0 GB/s payload per direction) at all times — idle and under load. This is a persistent 'downgraded' link state, not an idle power-management artifact. Under the measured int8 ASR workload (SM util 74–82%, 10.7× RT), no obvious PCIe bottleneck was observed. No direct bus-traffic measurement was taken (no DCGM; nvidia-smi power field is [N/A] on these Pascal cards), so the conclusion is 'no obvious bottleneck' rather than 'PCIe is irrelevant to performance.'
